summary: Tested accrual rate display (PersonnelAccrualRates card in Edit Personnel dialog) and accrual processing (monthly + holiday) in Branding Settings. All backend endpoints (5 tests) and frontend flows pass. UI card shows Operations badge, hire date 2023-01-15, 3.6 years of service, vacation tier '3 - 5 years' at 8 hrs/mo with 240 cap, sick tier 'Hire - 5 years' at 4 hrs/mo with 1080 cap, holiday 12 hrs x 11. Process Monthly Accrual and Process Holiday Accrual buttons work end-to-end with proper results dialogs and toasts.

issues: Recurring console error: /api/platform/video/intro_video_a1702399.mp4 returns invalid stream (DEMUXER_ERROR_NO_SUPPORTED_STREAMS) - not related to this feature but noisy in logs

critical_code_review_comments: process-holiday-accrual endpoint takes holiday_name as a query parameter (not body). Works but consider using a Pydantic body model for cleaner API contract.
PersonnelAccrualRates has unused imports (Button, useAuth toast, Clock, CheckCircle2) - minor cleanup.
Holiday accrual has no cap - could accumulate indefinitely; consider a rollover cap similar to vacation/sick.
process_monthly_accrual does not track whether it was already run for the current month - repeated clicks will re-accrue. Consider guarding by last_accrual_date month check.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Accrual features fully working. Personnel edit uses pencil icon (not text 'Edit'). Test User hire_date 2023-01-15 shows 3.6 years so vacation tier is '3 - 5 years'.
